rfp_contact.quote: For the purposes of this procurement process, the “RFP Contact” will be Indra Ghosh, Supervisor of Purchasing and Treasury. PublicBids@rockyview.ca

submission_method.quote: Proposals must be received electronically on or before the Submission Deadline May 14, 2025, 2:00 PM MST. Subject to the process described below, proposals submitted after the Submission Deadline will be rejected.

contract_term.quote: The agreement resulting from this RFP shall be in effect from the date of official acceptance by the County until December 31, 2025, subject to the following: (a) When mutually agreeable between the County and the successful proponent, this agreement may be renewed under the same terms and conditions for a period of up to one (1) additional year and said option to renew this agreement for an additional one (1) year period, shall be in effect for each year thereafter for a total period not to exceed three (3) years.
contract_term.value: in effect from the date of official acceptance by the County until December 31, 2025, with renewal options for up to three (3) years

scope_of_deliverables.quote: Rocky View County is seeking proposals from experienced and qualified consultants to conduct a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, followed by the development of a Request for Proposal (RFP) document (Scope of work) in collaboration with the County’s appointed project team members, and to serve as an advisor for the ERP evaluation and selection process.
scope_of_deliverables.value: Conduct a comprehensive ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, develop an RFP document, and advise on ERP evaluation and selection.

mandatory_submission_requirements.quote:
B. MANDATORY SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS
B.1 
 Submission Form  
Proponents are instructed to complete the Submission Form set out in Appendix B of this RFP and include it in their proposal submission. The Submission Form is to be signed by an authorized representative of the proponent.  
B.2  
Pricing  
Proponents are instructed to complete the Pricing Schedule as set out in Section F of Appendix D of this RFP and include it in their proposal submission.  Instructions on how to complete the Pricing Schedule are set out in Appendix C of this RFP.  
B.3  Other Mandatory Submission Requirements 
Proponents are instructed to complete and submit the Mandatory Evaluation Table below for their proposal. Proponents will be evaluated based on their responses to the criteria listed within the Mandatory Evaluation Table below. Any ‘No’ answers within the table will result in automatic disqualification unless the included justification satisfies the evaluation committee.

evaluation_criteria.quote:
EVALUATION CRITERIA GUIDELINES: 
Each Proposal submission shall include, but not be limited to, the following information: 
Proponent’s Qualifications and Experience (VALUE: 10%) 
This criterion evaluates the Proponent's overall experience and qualifications in delivering similar projects or services. It assesses the Proponent’s track record, industry experience, and demonstrated ability to successfully execute projects of comparable scope and complexity.

pricing_structure.quote: Proponents are to complete the Pricing Schedule as set out in Section F of Appendix D of this RFP and include it in their proposal. The Pricing Schedule must be completed by filling in the blank spaces under the headings “Unit Price” and “Total Bid” for each item and filling in the blank space for the overall “Total Bid” amount.

vendor_experience_required.quote: The Proponent’s appointed Project Manager (and back-up Project Manager) shall have a minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period.

references_required.quote: Proponents shall provide a MINIMUM OF THREE (3) (preferably PUBLIC SECTOR) client references for whom they have provided SIMILAR/ IDENTICAL SERVICES WITHIN THE LAST SEVEN (7) YEARS.

data_security_requirements.quote: Define the security protocols and measures necessary to safeguard sensitive information stored within the ERP system. This encompasses role-based access controls, data encryption, audit trails, and compliance with data protection regulations.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Vendor Shortlisting and Demonstration Preparation: The RFP Evaluation Committee will select the Vendors that will be shortlisted to provide a product demonstration and assist the County in clarifying any outstanding queries with shortlisted Vendors prior to the product demonstration process.
